  3) Offline ops  for air-gapped installs we provide an install bundle + offline artifact transfer process; confirm who on your side owns artifact transfer and media ingestion.

Thanks Mike  helpful. Dev/Rishi, adding you both to handle the technical/security answers below (and we can pick a time for the infra deep-dive).

Quick answers and notes from Redwood: 

1) Hardware compatibility:
- A100 (40GB) nodes are fully supported and are our recommended baseline for production throughput with current open models.
- V100 nodes are not recommended for production for recent models due to memory constraints; they can be used for low-throughput evals but we should exclude them from the primary inference pool.

2) Upgrade model & cadence: 
- For air-gapped installs we provide versioned install bundles and an offline upgrade guide. Major model/engine rollouts are typically quarterly. Patching (security and critical bug fixes) can be delivered monthly via an offline patch bundle you can apply during your maintenance window.
- We support staged upgrades (canary on a subset of nodes) even in air-gapped environments  this requires isolated staging nodes that you control.

3) Offline artifact transfer:
- Typical flow: Redwood prepares signed artifact tarballs (checksum + signature). Your infra team ingests via secure USB or internal file transfer, verifies checksums/signatures, and our offline installer runs locally.
- Well supply a signed verification tool and transfer checklist. Rishi  can you confirm any additional attestation requirements you need?

4) Network & egress:
- In fully air-gapped mode, model storage and inference runtime do not require outbound internet. For telemetry and billing we support an on-prem metering proxy that your security team can allow outbound only to specific endpoints, or you can choose a fully offline billing report that you pull.

Attachments: redwood_onprem_hardware_onepager.pdf (included again).

Proposed next step: 45-min tech deep-dive with Emma + infra/security on 2027-04-21 or 2027-04-22. Ill send a Doodle unless you prefer a fixed time.
